scope: One invented public frame through the owned Windows pipe, strict existing-host-key SSH, public Linux receiver and existing qualified Debug Rust public-frame mode; not a credential channel or SDK session.
source_hash_semantics: Measured working-file bytes, not necessarily CRLF-normalized Git blob identities.
orchestrator_portability: Private MAIN orchestrators depend on local metadata and are not portable public launchers or bit-exact reproduction artifacts. Published helpers, receiver protocol and neutral prerequisite/root layout are documented separately.
history: Initial transport scaffolds were nonoperational and never executed; NO_GO is preserved.
Operational R2 was NO_GO before execution for a literal Windows slash-path mismatch and reservation order; normalized shared validation passed eight local pure checks.
First R2 local preparation stopped before OUT, any Job or SSH because cross-API Windows ctime representations differed; all five source pins matched and common identity and birthtime matched.

Corrected Windows predicates retain cross-API dev, ino, size, mtime, mode, nlink and birthtime checks, and check ctime stability independently within each named and handle API; ten pure checks passed. No Linux checks were weakened.
The earlier 11-case native admission campaign, its reservations and results were not replayed or overwritten; this one new case is distinct.
limitations: Zero sessions, healthy=false and zero service calls are closed-plan/source invariants, not independent network or syscall telemetry.
The receiver only forwards its compiled-in invented public tuple and cannot send real credentials or enter single-session mode.
No provider credentials loaded, no Rambler calls, no raw input or remote payload recorded; private host, account, paths and case identifiers omitted.
Local postinspection alone does not establish delivery without the matched terminal, EOF, exit zero and owned cleanup.
Trusted CPython, stdlib, OpenSSH, server login startup, procfs, no concurrent same-UID mutation and root/kernel/swap/launcher-buffer assumptions remain. Job ownership contains lifetime, not secrecy.
Real credential channel, SDK session, provisioning and full backend remain unqualified; live GO is false. No latency, semantic or universal perfection claim.
